applyTo: '**/*.js'

# JavaScript

- For the Qooxdoo frontend in `services/static-webserver/client/source/class/`,
  follow the surrounding class structure and naming. Run `npm run linter` or
  `npm run linter-fix` to lint with ESLint and `eslint-config-qx`.
- For Playwright end-to-end tests in `tests/e2e-frontend/`, follow the existing
  test and fixture layout.
